integrity: The channel definition is reconstructed directly from the primary source. Explicit lower-bound codes are bundled. Two distinct integer formulations are rebuilt from first principles and solved to zero MIP gap by the packaged verifier.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact result only for the ternary alphabet, one absorption, and blocklengths 2 through 5. The upper bounds are computer-assisted mixed-integer proofs, not proof-assistant certificates. Full text of the 2024 follow-up conference paper was not accessible during comparison.
title: Exact ternary one-absorption optima through length \(5\)
